Between Rs. 90,000/- to Rs. 1,30,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: About NHSRC
content_sections.text: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is based in New Delhi. Under this Terms of Reference, NHSRC is seeking applications on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare for a post in the Central TB Division. The post covers TB HIV collaborative activities and TB associated with comorbidities under the national TB programme (NTEP).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: MBBS from institution, recognized by Medical Council of India. Working knowledge of computers. Five years' experience in working in similar area. The notice lists this as preferential, not essential. The age limit is upto 65 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Alongside the age limit, the notice states that the candidate should be ready to travel extensively. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration range for the Technical Officer (TB comorbidities) post is between Rs. 90,000/- to Rs. 1,30,000/- per month. The notice does not say how the exact amount within this range is fixed, and it names no allowances. The engagement is purely on a contractual basis. The length of the contract is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Technical Officer (TB comorbidities) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these responsibilities: To handle day to day correspondence at Central TB Division pertaining to TB HIV program collaborative activities and TB associated with comorbidities (Eg. Diabetes, Tobacco, Hypertension, Malnutrition, Occupational Diseases, Chronic Respiratory Diseases). To assist the CTD in maintaining the database of stake holders in TBHIV collaboration and TB associated with comorbidities. To facilitate the national/regional trainings on TBHIV collaborative initiatives and TB associated with comorbidities. To conduct supervisory visits to states/districts to monitor implementation TB HIV/comorbidities collaboration and report to CTD. To assist in monitoring the TB HIV/comorbidities activities performance of the States on relevant indicators derived from periodic reports. To assist in compiling TB HIV/comorbidities reports to the Government of India and stakeholders. Facilitating organization and conduct of meetings with various partners/ stake holders, state and national functionaries on TBHIV/comorbidities issues. To work in collaboration with technical officers of other thematic areas of the program on cross cutting issues. To facilitate change management with respect to use of ICT & Nikshay tools for concerned data entry, validation & its use for public health action. To identify various programme linkages across different national programmes, to develop NTEP programme on TB co- morbidities. To identify and facilitate operational research in TB- HIV/comorbidities. To assist CTD in collaborating with other National Programmes / partners. To assist in compiling comorbidity management reports to the Government of India and stakeholders. To assist in conducting meetings with partners, documenting the minutes, compiling reports on action taken and providing feedback. To work in collaboration with technical officers of other thematic areas of the program on cross cutting issues. To assist Central TB Division in organizing periodic meetings/workshops/reviews of State program managers at national level. Any other job assigned as per programme need.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHSRC Technical Officer (TB comorbidities)
content_sections.text: Candidates must fill in the online application correctly. The form is available on the NHSRC website ( http://nhsrcindia.org ). Applications are accepted only in the prescribed online application format. The last date for receiving applications is 30 November 2026, and the application window is open as of 7 November 2026. The notice does not name any documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice does not describe the selection stages. It gives one written test condition. If the recruitment process includes a written test, the minimum qualifying mark will be 70%.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHSRC Technical Officer (TB comorbidities) post?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications for the NHSRC Technical Officer (TB comorbidities) post is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for NHSRC Technical Officer (TB comorbidities)?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and working knowledge of computers.

faq.question: Q3. Is experience required for the NHSRC Technical Officer (TB comorbidities) post?
faq.answer: Five years' experience in working in a similar area is listed as a preferential qualification, not an essential one.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NHSRC Technical Officer (TB comorbidities)?
faq.answer: The age limit is upto 65 years. The notice also states that candidates should be ready to travel extensively.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of NHSRC Technical Officer (TB comorbidities)?
faq.answer: The remuneration range is between Rs. 90,000/- to Rs. 1,30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for NHSRC Technical Officer (TB comorbidities)?
faq.answer: Fill in the online application on the NHSRC website (http://nhsrcindia.org). Applications are accepted only in the prescribed online application format.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualifying mark if there is a written test?
faq.answer: If the recruitment process includes a written test, the minimum qualifying mark will be 70%.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NHSRC Technical Officer (TB comorbidities) post permanent?
faq.answer: No. NHSRC is filling the post on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare purely on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Does the NHSRC Technical Officer (TB comorbidities) job involve travel?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must be ready to travel extensively, and the duties include supervisory visits to states/districts to monitor TB HIV/comorbidities collaboration.
